subject: science
passage: Sea cucumbers, soft-bodied relatives of sea stars that live on the ocean floor, can change the stiffness of their body walls within seconds. When threatened, many species stiffen their skin so that they become difficult to bite or to pull from a ______ they need to squeeze through a narrow gap between rocks, they can soften the same tissue until it becomes remarkably pliable. Engineers have studied this ability while designing materials that switch between rigid and flexible states.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "When threatened, many species stiffen their skin … from a crevice" and "when they need to squeeze … they can soften the same tissue" are both independent clauses. "However" is a transition word, not a conjunction, so it can't join the clauses by itself. A semicolon must come before "however," and a comma after it.
explanation.A: Incorrect. With no punctuation before "however," the two independent clauses run together.
explanation.B: Correct. The semicolon joins the two independent clauses, and the comma after "however" sets off the transition from the clause that follows.
explanation.C: Incorrect. A comma before "however" still creates a comma splice, because "however" can't join two independent clauses.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Commas around "however" can't join two independent clauses; this creates a comma splice.
